changeSet.author: code-review
changeSet.comment: Telegram usernames can be freed and reclaimed by a different account; before enforcing DB-level uniqueness, keep only the most-recently-logged-in row per (lower-cased) username and null the rest, so the unique index below can be created without failing on pre-existing duplicates.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users u SET username = NULL WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND u.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(username)) id FROM users WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LOWER(username), last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC )

rollback.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_username_lower_idx ON users (LOWER(username))

changeSet.author: code-review
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_username_lower_unique_idx ON users (LOWER(username)) WHERE username IS NOT NULL
